item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Swedish sausage stew – a warm and creamy everyday favourite with tender potato cubes and slices of juicy sausage tossed in a mild, tasty paprika and cream sauce with soft onions. (1+6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Chicken afritada, a classic Filipino chicken stew braised in a flavourful tomato sauce with potatoes, carrots and peppers. Served with steamed rice. (3+7) GREEN DISH: Dish Tofu afritada braised in a flavourful tomato sauce with potatoes, carrots and peppers. Served with steamed rice. (3+7)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: GREEN DISH: Dish Pad krapow with tofu, fresh chilli, soy, sesame, Thai basil and a fried egg, served with rice. (2+7+8+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Turkey cuvette marinated in warm spices, served with mashed potatoes and baked sweet potatoes. Served with a jus flavoured with orange. (6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Tempeh (pea-based) marinated in warm spices, served with mashed potatoes and baked sweet potatoes. Served with a jus flavoured with orange. (6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Red Thai curry with chicken, coconut and vegetables served with jasmine rice and topped with peanuts and bean sprouts. Served with chilli sauce, coriander, lime and Thai cucumber salad. (3+4+5+7) GREEN DISH: Dish Red Thai curry with tofu, coconut and vegetables served with jasmine rice and topped with peanuts and bean sprouts. Served with chilli sauce, coriander, lime and Thai cucumber salad. (3+4+5+7)
